description: This file defines a class `HTMLPurifier_PropertyList` that implements a property list with support for nested/parent property lists, allowing properties to be retrieved, set, reset, and squashed into a combined array.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_PropertyList
classes.description: A class implementing a property list with capabilities for inheritance, caching, and manipulation of property key-value pairs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a property list, optionally with a parent list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given key, searching parent lists recursively if necessary; throws an exception if not found.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a value for a specific key in this property list.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a specific key exists in this property list.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets a specific key or the entire property list to default (clear the data).

methods.name: squash
methods.description: Merges this property list with its parent to produce a single combined array, using caching unless forced.
